environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TCP passthrough on port 443 terminated at nginx with TLS. The nginx reverse proxy forwards to localhost:8080 with no request filtering. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The SQLite database is on an EBS volume mounted at /var/data/. No additional middleware or request inspection is configured. The application authenticates users via HMAC tokens but the search endpoint constructs SQL via string interpolation on user input.

config.tls_termination: nginx on instance, proxy_pass to localhost:8080
